title: S.I. No. 3 of 2026 - Income Tax (Amount for Remission of Tax) Regulations
text:
5
Income Tax (Amount for Remission of Tax) Regulations
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2026, No. 3
[ 12th January, 2026 ]
In exercise of the power conferred under section 151 of the Income
Tax Act, Cap. 15.02, the Minister responsible for finance makes these
Regulations:
Citation
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Income Tax (Amount
for Remission of Tax) Regulations, 2026.
Amount for remission of tax
2. For the purposes of section 130(3)(c) of the Income Tax Act,
Cap. 15.02, the higher amount of tax must not exceed fifty thousand
dollars.
Made this 8th day of January, 2026.
PHILIP J. PIERRE,
Minister responsible for finance.
SAINT LUCIA
